hero.prompt: Use case: product-photography / website campaign cutout. Create ONE photorealistic editorial floral arrangement isolated on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background for an existing French florist website. Image1 is the APPROVED WEBSITE BOARD: reproduce only the character of its HERO flowers at the top, not the web page, logo, text, buttons, layout or shop/staff. Image2 is botanical species/color guidance from the shop's real bouquet. Need a single airy, sculptural, life-size studio flower arrangement of pink gerberas (one large principal bloom facing three-quarter front), an ivory rose, tiny lilac and white baby's-breath blossoms, pink lisianthus, natural slender green leaves, very long delicate stems. Elegant photographic realism, natural imperfect petals, soft warm daylight, detailed petal translucency. Arrangement sits mostly in the RIGHT two thirds of a 4:5 canvas, with airy upper branches reaching left and one sweeping curved stem reaching lower left; ensure stems and flowers all inside the image with breathing room. Open organic structure, not a wrapped round bouquet, no vase, no holder, no person, no shadow rectangle or opaque background, no typography, no watermarks. Mostly botanical greens and pink/cream tones. Soft natural dimensional shading within the flowers, compositing-ready clean fine edges. This is an illustrative campaign asset, NOT a claimed product or shop photo. Output transparent background.
